_doc: Scenes that make a town look lived in, by the hour (world/innerMap/townScenes.js over world/innerMap/townLife.js). Every choice is a hash of the town, the day, the hour and the person — never the shared RNG. market: the square's stalls (TownProps tp_stall) staffed in hours [open, close) by vendors (roles in vendorRoles order, real townsfolk), standing behind the counter (behind: tiles up from the stall's anchor row; front: one below) and hawking every hawkEvery seconds the goods of stallGoods[role] the town's market actually stocks (world/settlementMarket.js); shoppers stand at a stall's front, haggle (a pair of lines), and browse on to another stall (browse chance). church: services each day at services[] (start, end hours), plus holyDay.extra every holyDay.every days; the bell rings bellLead hours before, and a share of adults (holyDay.share on the holy day) walk in and sit in the pews till it ends; the priest preaches lines of the town's faith (sermon by faith id, else generic with {faith}/{tenet}). interiors: what the player sees inside each kind of building — staff at their station (staffAt furniture, behind it or beside it), patrons seated round seatsAt furniture, crowdByHour (24 hours) how many come in, stay seconds [min,max]. tavern: a bard from bard.hours, events every eventEvery seconds (weights), the arguments that spill into a scuffle the keeper breaks up; drunkShare of those leaving a tavern after drunkAfter o'clock stagger home. tend: what a tradesperson does out front of their workplace by building type (prop: a town prop they work at, within reach tiles of the door; tool: a tool in hand swung each swing seconds; sound). crier: one townsperson cries the news in the square every everyHours in hours. camp: at a Dawn of Man camp the eldest tells stories by the fire in hours, listeners sit round. Lines: {good}, {name}, {faith}, {tenet}, {news}, {ruler}, {town}.

any: Best {good} this side of the river!
none: Come and see, come and see!

haggle: Two and a half, and I'm robbing myself.
Fresh this morning, on my mother's life.
Then go and rob someone else!
I'll take two, if you knock a penny off.
Done. You drive a hard bargain.
And the roads were safer last week.

call: To prayers! The bell is rung!
open: Let us begin, in the name of {faith}.

any: {tenet} is the road, and the road is long.
Who among us has not strayed? Return!
Give to the poor, and the gods give to you.
The harvest is the gods' gift — waste none of it.
Be at peace with your neighbour, friends.
solaris: The Sun sees every deed, friends.
Walk in the light, and fear no dark.
tidemother: The tide takes, and the tide gives back.
Safe harbour to all who keep faith.
earthroot: The roots bind us all, one to another.
Be patient as the oak is patient.
ironfaith: The soul is forged in trial!
Labour is prayer. Work, and be blessed.
starseers: The stars have written our road.
Charity is the wisest of virtues.
stoneheart: Honour the ancestors who built before you.
Craft well, and your work outlives you.
stormfather: Courage! The Stormfather loves the bold!
Live free, and die with glory.
dunewalkers: Turn no stranger from your door.
Fair trade is a holy thing.
flameheralds: The Flame burns away all impurity!
Let your zeal light the dark!

songs: ♪ Raise your cups to the road! ♪
♪ Down by the river, my love… ♪
♪ Fill my cup, fill my cup! ♪
cheer: Play the one about the miller!

toast: To the bottom of the cup!
banter: …and then the cow fell in the well!
argue: Say that again, I dare you!
Was it? I don't see your name on it.
drunk: I love you, all of you…

close: That is all! Go about your business!
fallback: The roads are open and the gates are kept!

stories: …and the great bear spoke, and said…
The stars are the fires of the dead.
…so the fox stole the fire, and ran…
listen: Tell the one about the bear!
